title: Peter Ward (former Head of Commercial Operations, Oura) reports from the builder community — 'a real and reassuring momentum as I see more and more builders choosing public benefit missions'
summary: Writing up LA Tech Week's Health and Wellness Innovators Summit, a founder and former Oura commercial operations lead records what he is seeing across the room: founders picking public benefit structures at the outset rather than retrofitting them. He places it alongside a wider appetite among builders to move past the extractive side of consumer tech.
blockquote: The work of Eric Ries’ Incorruptible is displaying a real and reassuring momentum as I see more and more builders choosing public benefit missions to guide their products from the beginning.
attribution_title: Founder, holistic health · former Head of Commercial Operations, Oura
